analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($1.40) vs SMA5 ($1.44) / SMA20 ($1.49) / SMA50 ($1.43): trading below short-to-mid term trends, above long-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100 ($1.26) / SMA200 ($1.28): maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (22.3%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 59.0 → 44.0 (exiting oversold): preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram -0.0057 → -0.0193 (worsening): continued bearish pressure.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid $1.49): band width at 13.65% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38): based on mid-band Bollinger and Pivot S1 ($1.26).
· Swing resistance ($1.47): below 5-day high ($1.53) and Bollinger upper band ($1.59).
· 5-day / 20-day high-low pattern: sideways range, no clear Higher Low or Lower High confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear direction.
